screenLevelIssues.explanation: To match Figma's vertically centered layout for the content cluster, the ScrollView content container needs to center its content vertically. The current implementation aligns content to the top.

The sum of the icon width (56px), gap (16px), and text width (213px) equals 285px. With card padding (32px), the total required width is 317px, which exceeds the card's fixed width of 297px. The text must be flexible (`flex: 1`) to wrap correctly without overflowing or breaking layout.
